subject: Re: Duplicate charge on June invoice — proposed netting / credit memo
messages:
From: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@acme-retail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Duplicate charge on June invoice (INV-2026-06-ACME)

Jordan —

We reviewed our June invoice and found a duplicated line for the ‘Realtime connector’ consumption (two identical line items for 2026-06-23). Our AP team has flagged it and placed a payment hold for the amount in dispute (~USD 6,200). Can you confirm Redwood's view and advise whether you can issue a credit or refund?

We prefer a credit to apply to the next invoice but can accept a refund if provisioning requires it. Also note: we are registered in India for GST; any refund may be subject to TDS. AP contact is accounts-payable@acme-retail.com.

Thanks,
Ravi Menon
Head of Finance, Acme Retail

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@acme-retail.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Duplicate charge on June invoice (INV-2026-06-ACME)

Ravi —

Thanks for flagging this and sorry for the disruption. I see the duplicate in our billing system and confirmed it's an ingestion-related double-count that should not have charged you twice.

Options we can take immediately:
- Issue a credit memo for the disputed amount and apply it to your next invoice (preferred, fastest).
- Issue a refund via wire/ACH once TDS/withholding paperwork is completed.

To process a refund (if you choose that) our finance team needs a TDS certificate or tax residency proof so we can calculate withholding correctly. If you opt for a credit memo we can issue it today and you should see it as a negative line on your next statement.

I’ve looped in Monica from Billing to prepare the credit memo and help with the TDS path if needed. Monica — could you prepare a credit memo draft for USD 6,200 and confirm whether netting is possible against the next invoice dated 2026-09-01?

Next steps: please confirm you want a credit note (recommended) or refund, and attach the TDS/residency doc if refund is required.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@acme-retail.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Duplicate charge on June invoice (INV-2026-06-ACME)

Hi Ravi / Jordan —

I have prepared a provisional credit memo for USD 6,200 (ACME-CM-2026-08-16). We can apply it as a netting credit against your September invoice. That will clear the payment hold immediately on your side and keeps reconciliation simple.

If Acme requires a cash refund instead, we will need:
- Signed request from AP confirming refund bank details
- TDS certificate / tax residency doc (to determine whether Redwood must withhold tax)
- For refunds over USD 5k, our AR policy requires manager approval; I have noted that in the internal thread.

Attached: provisional credit memo (PDF stub). Once Jordan confirms internal approval threshold, I can finalize and post it to your account.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Billing Specialist, Redwood Inference
Attachment: ACME-2026-06-credit-memo.pdf (pdf, 56KB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Duplicate charge on June invoice — approval for courtesy credit over threshold?

Karthik / Markus —

Acme (Strategic) has a duplicated line on June invoice amounting to USD 6,200. Monica can issue a credit memo that nets against next month, but since the amount exceeds our $5k AR refund threshold I am requesting approval to finalize the credit memo (prefer netting vs. cash refund). This is a goodwill correction for a clear billing error; no contract change required.

Key points:
- Proposed fix: issue credit memo ACME-CM-2026-08-16 and apply to 2026-09 invoice.
- Impact: reduces outstanding by $6,200; negative impact to August MRR is immaterial (one-off).
- If Acme insists on cash refund, they will need to provide TDS certificate and AR will process a wire (requires GL reversal).

Can I have an approval reply by end of day? Monica is standing by to post.

Thanks,
Jordan

From: Ravi Menon <ravi.menon@acme-retail.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, accounts-payable@acme-retail.com
Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Duplicate charge on June invoice (INV-2026-06-ACME)

Jordan / Monica —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We accept the credit memo and prefer netting to a refund to avoid the TDS paperwork. Please finalize ACME-CM-2026-08-16 and apply to the invoice scheduled for 2026-09-01.

AP has lifted the payment hold contingent on the credit being applied; once posted we will release the outstanding balance for immediate payment. Attached is our TDS certificate for your records (per your earlier note) — although we won’t need a cash refund at this time.

Appreciate the help.

Best regards,
Ravi Menon
Head of Finance, Acme Retail
Attachment: acme_tds_certificate_2026.pdf (pdf, 120KB)
